questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: Two dice are thrown together. Find the probability of getting a sum of 9.
questions.exp: Combinations giving sum 9: (3,6),(4,5),(5,4),(6,3) = 4 outcomes. Total outcomes=36. P=4/36=1/9, equivalent fraction form 4/36 matches directly.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: In a data set, if the mean of 8 numbers is 24, and one number 30 is removed, find the new mean.
questions.exp: Sum of 8 numbers=8×24=192. After removing 30: sum=162, count=7. New mean=162/7=23.14≈23.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If P is coded as 16, Q as 17, then how is 'BANK' coded (sum of position values)?
questions.exp: B=2, A=1, N=14, K=11 (position in alphabet). Sum = 2+1+14+11 = 28.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A is the father of B. B is the husband of C. D is the daughter of C. How is A related to D?
questions.exp: B is C's husband, D is C's daughter, so D is also B's daughter. A is B's father, making A the grandfather of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a queue of 30 people, X is 14th from the front. If Y is exactly opposite X (i.e., the same distance from the back as X is from the front), what is Y's position from the front?
questions.exp: X is 14th from front, meaning 14th from back would be position 30-14+1=17. Y, being symmetric to X, is the 17th from the front.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Cheque, Draft, Passbook, Currency
questions.exp: Cheque, Draft, and Currency are all forms of payment/monetary instruments. Passbook is a record-keeping document, not a payment instrument — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If in a certain code, 'LOAN' is written as 'MPBO', how is 'BANK' written in the same code?
questions.exp: Each letter shifted +1: L+1=M,O+1=P,A+1=B,N+1=O. Similarly B+1=C,A+1=B,N+1=O,K+1=L = CBOL.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: All banks are financial institutions. Some financial institutions offer insurance. Which conclusion follows?
questions.exp: Since some financial institutions offer insurance, and all banks are financial institutions, it's possible some banks offer insurance — the most reasonable conclusion among the choices.

questions.subject: Banking

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next: J, L, O, S, ?
questions.exp: Letter positions: J(10), L(12), O(15), S(19). Differences: 2, 3, 4 — increasing by 1 each time. Next difference = 5. 19+5 = 24th letter = X.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Loan : Repayment :: Investment : ?
questions.exp: A loan is followed by repayment over time. An investment is followed by returns over time. Same input-outcome relationship.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If 'CREDIT' is coded as 'DSFEJU', how is 'DEBIT' coded in the same pattern?
questions.exp: Each letter shifted +1: D+1=E,E+1=F,B+1=C,I+1=J,T+1=U = EFCJU.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: P is the wife of Q. R is the son of Q. S is the sister of R. How is P related to S?
questions.exp: Q is P's husband. R is Q's son, so R is also P's son. S is R's sister, so S is also P's daughter. P is S's mother.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 36 customers, M is 15th from the left and N is 10th from the right. How many customers are between M and N?
questions.exp: N's position from left = 36-10+1 = 27. Customers between M(15th) and N(27th) = 27-15-1 = 11.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A and B together can complete a task in 12 days. After working together for 4 days, A leaves and B completes the remaining work in 16 more days. In how many days can A alone complete the task?
questions.exp: Combined rate = 1/12 per day. Work done together in 4 days = 4/12 = 1/3. Remaining work = 2/3, completed by B alone in 16 days, so B's rate = (2/3)/16 = 1/24 per day. A's rate = 1/12 - 1/24 = 1/24 per day. So A alone also takes 24 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: If 3 men or 5 women can complete a task in 12 days, how many days will 6 men and 5 women together take to complete it?
questions.exp: 3 men=5 women in efficiency, so 1 man=5/3 women. 6 men=10 women. 6 men+5 women=15 women equivalent. 5 women take 12 days, so 1 woman-day of work=1/60 of task. 15 women take 60/15=4 days.
